name: browse-resume-ai
description: Summarize the current web page with one click, using your Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

scripts.dist: wxt build && rm -rf dist/chrome && mkdir -p dist && cp -R .output/chrome-mv3 dist/chrome
scripts.test:linux: docker build -f test/linux/Dockerfile -t browse-resume-ai-linux . && docker run --rm browse-resume-ai-linux
scripts.test:windows-scripts: docker build -f test/windows/Dockerfile -t browse-resume-ai-windows-scripts . && docker run --rm browse-resume-ai-windows-scripts
